أتصادر (form VI)
# أَتَصَادَرُ (ʔataṣādaru) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.da.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
# أَتَصَادَرَ (ʔataṣādara) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.da.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
# أَتَصَادَرْ (ʔataṣādar) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.dar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
